info.title: eqdata — migrations for eQuantic.Core.Data
info.description: The eqdata command-line tool for eQuantic.Core.Data: generates database migrations by comparing the model against a committed snapshot, and checks a live database for drift away from it.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Where the files go, relative to the project, / or \ between folders;
they also name the namespace. Defaults to Migrations.
